entries.title: Save a reproducible HTTP baseline
entries.command:
curl --silent --show-error --max-time 10 --dump-header baseline.headers --output baseline.body 'https://app.example.test/health'
sha256sum baseline.headers baseline.body
entries.context: Bash, curl and coreutils. Replace the reserved example hostname with an approved lab service. Use a fresh output directory.
entries.interpretation: Retain status, headers, body and hash together; a hash without its request and timestamp cannot explain behavior.
entries.pitfall: A proxy error page may return 200. Confirm an application-specific marker.
entries.cleanup: No state change is intended. Retain sanitized output and remove only the disposable artifacts created for this test.
entries.verification: Reference example; not executed against an engagement target. Confirm syntax against the installed tool version.

entries.title: Check revocation with old and fresh sessions
entries.command:
1. Confirm A can read a private canary record.
2. Revoke A through the supported admin operation.
3. Replay the same read with A's existing session.
4. Repeat with A's fresh session and an unaffected authorized user.
5. Compare the observed window with the documented enforcement delay.
entries.context: A disposable application with an explicit revocation contract and synthetic records.
entries.interpretation: Access after the required enforcement deadline is evidence only if the protected marker is returned and controls work.
entries.pitfall: Token expiry, a missing record and a backend outage can look like correct denial.
entries.cleanup: No state change is intended. Retain sanitized output and remove only the disposable artifacts created for this test.
entries.verification: Reference example; not executed against an engagement target. Confirm syntax against the installed tool version.
